import json, math
from pathlib import Path
snap=json.loads(Path("inputs/OBS.json").read_text())
summary=snap["summary"];metrics=snap.get("metrics") or {};trades=snap.get("trades",[])
assert summary["session_status"]=="finished"
assert len(trades)==0
assert metrics.get("total",0)==0
for key in ("fee","net_profit","open_pl","total_open_trades"):
    if key in metrics:assert abs(float(metrics[key]))<1e-9,key
for key in ("starting_balance","finishing_balance"):
    if key in metrics:assert abs(float(metrics[key])-10000)<1e-6,key
fund=metrics.get("funding") or {}
for key in ("cashflow","event_count"):
    if key in fund:assert abs(float(fund[key]))<1e-9,key
result={"status":"ZERO_TRADE_SNAPSHOT_PASS","N":len(trades),"metrics_keys":list(metrics),

Path("output/zero_snapshot.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(result))
